name: Checkstand lane bank, clipped to the drawn register bodies. The derived rect was [550.5,555.1,934.8,684.2]: the +/-45 pt window around the CHECKSTANDS label (733.1,611.8) swept in the impulse-rack row (y 595.1-603.8) and the frozen/seasonal shelf ends (y 555-577), so at bridge=20 it closed the 16 pt gap north of the lanes AND the 20 pt front action alley south of them. That cut the whole sales floor off from ENTRANCE, and because the KITCHEN label then sat in the orphaned region the service rule culled 78009 cells (the entire store) as one staff pocket -- the first-pass build_profile crash. Retightened to the register units themselves (x 564.5-898.5, y 619.7-657.2, padded ~8 in x, 8 north / 3 south) so the 11.5 pt lane gaps still seal while the impulse row, the queueing strip and the front action alley stay open.
